text:
Ari: Quick heads-up  Zephyr's security team just pinged AE, they need a focused FedRAMP office hour today. Can we repoint the 2pm workshop to a 11am security drop-in?
Priya: I can move but need someone to own the scrubbed demo dataset. Diego?
Diego: I can scrub and snapshot if you give me 30m. Link to runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/sandbox-scrub.
Marta: I can handle the compliance Q&A (10m) and bring the FedRAMP checklist.
Ari: Great. @cs_scheduler_bot can you create 11:00 PT event titled "Zephyr: FedRAMP drop-in (security + demo)" and add Zephyr_CISO + Solutions_Oncall?
cs_scheduler_bot: Creating event... ✅ Invite created: https://cal.redwood.com/event/zephyr-fedramp-1742204444 (11:00 PT / 18:00 UTC). Reminders: 20m before.
Priya: Draft agenda: 11:00 intro (Ari, 2m), 11:02 demo (Diego, 18m), 11:20 compliance Q&A (Marta, 10m), 11:30 actions & owners (Priya, 5m).
Diego: I'll trim demo to hosted-only path, then show a single slide for Dedicated isolation. Need the scrub snapshot by 10:25.
Ari: Diego, can you also prepare a small snippet showing KMS rotation config? One slide.
Diego: Yep.
Marta: I'll prepare a 1-pager checklist and a short FAQ for air-gap vs VPCoptions. Dropping it in chat during call.
Priya: Who owns post-call follow-ups and health doc update? We want to capture renewal signals.
Ari: I'll capture action items and mark anything critical as "renewal-risk" if they ask about on-prem or timeline slips.
Diego: Sandbox scrub snapshot: https://internal.redwood/artifacts/zephyr-snap-1742204444. PII removed per scrub-v2.
cs_scheduler_bot: Event updated by Diego. Invites resent.
Zephyr_CISO: (external) Confirmed 11:00 PT works for our security team. Thanks for the quick turn.
Priya: Pre-call sync at 10:30 DM huddle. Marta, can you join for Q&A prep?
Marta: Yes, I'll be there.
Solutions_Oncall: Note: If they request on-prem deployment details, escalate to Solutions team and ping #eng-platform.
Ari: Noted. Priya, can you add an explicit slide that lists who to loop for on-prem?
Priya: Will add slide: "Escalation path: Solutions -> Eng Platform -> Customer Success".
Diego: I'll record the demo and upload clips to the event doc with timestamps.
Priya: Post-call: I'll send a 2-question pulse (Y/N + confidence 1-5) and append the score to the account health page.
Ari: Also, if they ask about migration timelines, log that under "timeline risk" so renewal owners can follow up.
Priya: All set. cs_scheduler_bot, reminder 30m before?
cs_scheduler_bot: Reminder scheduled: 30m and 10m before event.
Ari: Thanks everyone  See you at 10:30 for pre-call sync.
